title: scRNAseq Hodge Decomposition Pipeline
description: Generalised single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline using discrete Hodge decomposition on SPD/log-Euclidean covariance manifolds to identify upstream cell types and upstream genes driving disease- or condition-associated changes in gene co-expression structure. Developed for ALS/FTLD research and validated against external perturbation benchmarks (Norman 2019 Perturb-seq, Shen 2024 CRISPR, TimeVault PC9, TCGA+GTEx glioma, Mendelian randomization).
